summary: Create v2.3.0 SRS requirements from two research artifacts covering SpecKiwi tool abandonment and Kiwi planner JSONL workflow tooling.
implied_requirements: Research candidates must map to canonical v2.3.0 Requirement IDs before implementation.
Tool gaps discovered while creating the SRS must be captured as v2.3.0 requirements.
Manual SRS-MD edits must remain exceptional and traceable to a missing tool capability.
